items.name: citation-guard
items.title: Citation Guard
items.description: A PostToolUse hook that checks every cite key in a .tex or .md file Claude just edited against the project's .bib and reports the ones that do not exist, and after a .bib edit reports duplicate keys and entries with no DOI, arXiv id, or URL. Catches an invented citation in the same step it was written. Use when drafting a thesis, paper, or proposal with AI assistance, where a fabricated reference is the one unrecoverable error.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
